## One engine

Every chat app in ChatOSS now runs the **same agent engine**. Chat, Kanban, Models and
Connect each used to carry their own copy of the streaming tool-calling loop — six forks
of one design, drifting apart. They are now one, so an improvement to the engine reaches
every app instead of needing five more edits.

What that means in use:

- **The same quality everywhere.** Compaction, the retry ladder, mid-turn message queueing
  (send while a reply is streaming and it is never dropped), and the honesty pass that
  makes an agent reconcile a claim it did not actually carry out — all of it now applies
  in every app, not just Code.
- **Each app keeps its own personality and its own tools.** Connect still manages MCP
  servers, Models still curates the picker, Kanban still runs the board. One engine does
  not mean one toolset: a casual Chat message is not charged for a repo agent's tooling.
- **Your conversations are untouched.** Each app still reads and writes exactly the chats
  it always had, in the same place.

Under the hood: `useCodeChat` is now `useChat`, App.tsx is ~1,000 lines smaller, and the
engine is the one that already backed Code and Create.

**macOS:** download the signed + notarized universal `ChatOSS_<version>_universal.dmg` — one build that runs natively on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs — built and uploaded from a developer machine with the Apple Developer ID certificate.

**Linux:** ChatOSS_*_amd64.AppImage or .deb
